name: Border Glow
description: Card container whose edges light up with a mesh-gradient border and soft outer glow that follows the pointer angle near the edges, with an optional automatic intro sweep.
contents: Rounded card wrapper that renders any children inside
Mesh gradient border layer, gradient fill layer near edges, and outer box-shadow glow layer
behavior: Glow and border appear on hover, strongest when the pointer is near an edge
Light cone rotates to point toward the pointer angle from the card center
Fades in over 0.25s on enter and out over 0.75s on leave
When animated is true, plays a one-time sweep around the card on mount without hover
Switches to light-surface styling when backgroundColor is a light hex color
editableByProps: Background color, corner radius, gradient colors and glow color as 'H S L' string
Glow size, intensity, cone width, edge sensitivity and fill strength
Intro sweep on mount through animated

needsCodeEdit.where: useEffect with animateValue calls and angleStart/angleEnd constants
boxShadow style on the root div

fixed: Root is a relative grid card with no sizing, so it needs content or a className for width and height
Uses at most three colors from colors, extras are ignored and short arrays reuse the last color
glowColor must be space separated H S L numbers, invalid values fall back to 40 80 80
Light-surface detection only works with hex backgroundColor values
Children sit in a scrollable flex column with overflow auto
Glow extends outside the card by glowRadius, so parents with overflow hidden will clip it
Requires Tailwind CSS classes and browser support for CSS mask composite and conic-gradient
Sweep runs once when animated becomes true
